{{Quote|Lou! Are you crazy? Pointing that thing at a Jedi? Put it down now!|A [[Spaceport police droid/Legends|spaceport police droid]] to Loubo, as he's holding a frying pan at the ready|<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>}}
A '''frying pan''' was a cooking device used across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its main purpose was cooking; however, sometimes it could be used as a melee weapon.

==History==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] searched for [[Darth Maul/Legends|his brother]] in [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]], choking the waitress [[Sassi/Legends|Sassi]], but he escaped before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived. The owner of the restaurant, [[Loubo/Legends|Loubo]] held a frying pan towards the Jedi in his confusion, but he was ordered by the [[Spaceport police droid/Legends|spaceport police droids]] to put it down.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In the script, the cook Loubo is holding a blaster to which the spaceport police droid says, "Lou! Are you crazy, pointing that thing at a Jedi?" Changing the prop into a frying pan turned this moment into a joke.|StarWars.com Trivia Gallery for "Brothers"|<ref name="Trivia" />}}
The scene where Loubo tried to pull the pan on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was originally intended for Lou to pull a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on him instead.<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/brothers-trivia-gallery|text="Brothers" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}}</ref>
